environment.description: Deployed behind an Istio service mesh with PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode on the namespace, requiring mutual TLS for all mesh-internal traffic. The ingress gateway has a custom EnvoyFilter resource that enforces downstream client certificate validation against an internal CA (CN must match pattern 'svc-*.internal.corp'). Additionally, the Kafka cluster uses SASL/SCRAM authentication with per-topic ACLs restricting produce permissions to a fixed set of service accounts provisioned through HashiCorp Vault's PKI secrets engine. The HTTP sidecar proxy (Envoy) will reject any connection to the application container on port 8080 that does not present a valid client certificate chained to the mesh CA - this occurs at the TCP handshake level before any HTTP request is processed.

config.kafka_acl_produce: restricted to vault-provisioned service accounts only
config.network_policy: deny-all with explicit allow for mesh-internal traffic only
